mapper.select: SELECT a.SEQ as seq, a.USER_KEY as userKey, b.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE as authCode, a.REG_DATE as regDate, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SURVEY_ANSWER ans WHERE ans.EVENT_SEQ = a.EVENT_SEQ AND ans.USER_SEQ = a.SEQ ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as hasAnswer FROM SURVEY_USER a LEFT JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING b ON a.EVENT_SEQ = b.EVENT_SEQ AND a.USER_KEY = b.USER_KEY WHERE a.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND b.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.SEQ DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_USER a INNER JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING b ON a.EVENT_SEQ = b.EVENT_SEQ AND a.USER_KEY = b.USER_KEY WHERE a.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND b.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTH_USER_MAPPING ( EVENT_SEQ, USER_SEQ, USER_KEY, GENERAL_AUTH_CODE, REG_ID, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{eventSeq}, (SELECT SEQ FROM SURVEY_USER WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND USER_KEY = #{userKey}), #{userKey}, #{generalAuthCode}, #{regId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_KEY FROM SURVEY_USER u INNER JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING m ON m.EVENT_SEQ = u.EVENT_SEQ AND m.USER_KEY = u.USER_KEY WHERE u.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND m.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SURVEY_ANSWER ans WHERE ans.EVENT_SEQ = u.EVENT_SEQ AND ans.USER_SEQ = u.SEQ )
